verdict.rationale: Aircall publishes a first-party API reference at developers.aircall.io/api-references covering endpoints such as starting outbound calls, pausing and resuming recording, retrieving transcriptions, summaries and sentiments, and managing campaigns. Step-by-step tutorials (e.g. Basic Auth usage) supplement it. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or runnable request examples in the reference, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
